Fuzzer for injecting HTTP/2 frames into bundle tile state and checking workspace leaks.

# Purpose
`fuzz_bundle_client` is a fuzz test entry point for the bundle client state machine. It sets up a workspace, initializes the test bundle environment, and feeds arbitrary input bytes into the HTTP/2 receive buffer used by the gRPC client. The file also overrides `fd_bundle_now()` so the fuzzer does not use real time and does not depend on timeout behavior.

The main fuzz target is `LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput()`. It creates a mock bundle environment, enables selected mock states based on a hash of the input, and then pushes input data into `frame_rx` in chunks. After each push, it calls `fd_bundle_client_step()` to process the data and clears any transmitted frames from `frame_tx`. At the end, it destroys the test environment and checks the workspace for leaks by verifying that all workspace entries are free.
